recent.statement: U.S. and Saudi airstrikes in Iraq will trigger a 10% spike in the VIX fear gauge within 24 hours
recent.evidence: No signal reports any VIX movement, let alone a 10% spike; S1 only notes airstrikes occurring and S2 is unrelated to Iraq or markets.

recent.statement: Iran launches a limited missile strike against a US military base in Iraq in response to recent US-Saudi airstrikes
recent.evidence: S1 reports Iran striking US forces in Jordan, not a missile strike on a US base in Iraq, and no signal shows an Iranian strike on a US base in Iraq during the window.

recent.statement: Escalation of US-Saudi airstrikes in Iraq leading to increased humanitarian aid requests in Baghdad
recent.evidence: S1 only reports U.S. and Saudi airstrikes drawing more countries into the fighting, with no mention of Iraq, Baghdad, or any increase in humanitarian aid requests there, and no other signal shows such an event.

recent.statement: VIX fear gauge rises above 20 due to escalating Middle East conflicts and typhoon Noul's humanitarian impact
recent.evidence: The VIX stood at 15.99 (-6.44%), well below the forecast threshold of 20, showing no fear-gauge spike within the window.

recent.statement: The Federal Reserve will signal a 50-basis-point rate hike at its July 28 meeting, pushing the Fed Funds rate to 5.75-6.00%
recent.evidence: No signal reports any FOMC rate decision from July 28, 2026 or a 50-basis-point hike to 5.75-6.00%; the only Fed-related signals are scheduled 2027 meetings, and risk-on markets (VIX 15.99, S&P futures +0.63%) show no sign of such a shock, so the window closed without evidence the event occurred.

recent.statement: Strait of Hormuz ship transits will drop 15% below 30-day average due to increased Iranian naval activity
recent.evidence: Signal 2 reports Strait of Hormuz daily transits at 10, 52% below its 30-day average of 21, far exceeding the forecast's 15% decline threshold.

recent.statement: Ukraine will conduct a naval strike on an Iranian vessel in the Black Sea
recent.evidence: No signal mentions any Ukrainian naval strike, Iranian vessel, or Black Sea activity; all signals concern Southeast Asian chokepoint transit counts, and an event of this magnitude would have been captured.

recent.statement: Kerch Strait ship transits will drop to 1-2 daily (73% below average) due to escalating Ukrainian conflict tensions.
recent.evidence: No signal reports Kerch Strait transit data at all; all available chokepoint signals concern Lombok, Windward, Yucatan, and Mindoro, so nothing shows the forecast drop occurred.

recent.statement: Escalation of hostilities in the Gaza Strip leading to a significant increase in humanitarian aid requests
recent.evidence: S1 only describes an ongoing conflict and humanitarian crisis as a standing condition, showing no escalation of hostilities or measurable surge in aid requests within the 24-hour window.

recent.statement: A major cyberattack on Ghana’s energy grid will cause a 48-hour blackout, linked to the country’s recent internet outage (connectivity drop score 1,294,430).
recent.evidence: No signal reports any cyberattack or 48-hour blackout on Ghana's energy grid — Ghana is not mentioned at all — and an event of that magnitude would have been captured within the window.

recent.statement: The FOMC will signal a 25-basis-point rate hike at its 2026-07-28 meeting, citing persistent inflation and tight labor markets.
recent.evidence: No signal reports any FOMC decision or hike signal from the 2026-07-28 meeting; the only Fed-related signals (S1-S3) merely list future scheduled meetings, so the forecast event is unsupported at window close.

recent.statement: Ukraine-Russia diplomatic talks will fail to produce ceasefire agreement
recent.evidence: S1 shows the Russian invasion of Ukraine still ongoing with active frontlines across eastern and southern regions, confirming no ceasefire agreement emerged during the window.
